records.title: Prevention of cruelty to animals (Amendment) Bill
details: b to e: In the meantime, the India Penal Code (IPC) has been replaced with Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 which also made provision for dealing with the animal cruelty. Considering all the suggestions, advice and present policy, the proposed bill is under examination.
